integrity: The proof is analytic: it identifies intrinsic coordinate-facet distances by orthogonal projection onto the cycle space, expresses the projection diagonal by effective resistance, and uses a Farkas/layer-cake proof of the nonnegative-flow cone for DAGs. The checker is finite corroboration only.
scientific_limitations: The theorem is for nonempty positive-dimensional flow polytopes of directed acyclic graphs in the intrinsic Euclidean metric. The facet-edge set must be determined separately. The lower-ideal formula is not asserted for directed graphs with cycles. Literature searches can miss unindexed or differently phrased work.
title: Euclidean inradius of acyclic flow polytopes as an effective-resistance cut ratio
